public_rationale: He excludes ChatGPT, so the test is whether other generative AI products were 'barely a blip'. They were not. Google data shown in court put Gemini at 350 million monthly users in March 2025, the month of the post. Meta said in September 2024 that Meta AI was nearing 500 million monthly users. Both are mass-market numbers. Some of this use comes from bundling into existing apps, and Gemini's daily users were far fewer (35 million). But by any ordinary reading, these are not blips.
limitations: Monthly counts are company-defined and partly driven by bundling.
The Gemini figure was published a month after the post, but it describes March 2025.
